slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Hinge Theorem: if two sides of one triangle are equal to two sides of another, and the included angle of the first is larger, then the third side of the first is longer.

Converse: if two sides are equal and the third side of the first is longer, then its included angle is larger.

Think of two doors of the same width: the one opened wider has a longer gap from its edge to the frame.
